name: Code Review
intent: Review code changes and report actionable findings before summaries.

source.text: Review code changes. Prioritize bugs, regressions, missing tests, and risks. Findings should lead the response.

inputs.description: A diff, patch, or list of changed files to inspect.

outputs.description: A review response with findings first and concise supporting context.

steps.title: Read diff
steps.description: Inspect the changed files or patch before making claims.

steps.title: Identify findings
steps.description: Look for bugs, regressions, missing tests, and user-visible risks.

steps.title: Report findings
steps.description: Return findings before any summary or supporting context.

rules.normalizedForm: The review response begins with findings before summary or context.

rules.sourceText: Prioritize bugs, risks, regressions, and missing tests over style-only comments.
rules.normalizedForm: Behavioral or correctness risks are ranked above style-only feedback.

checks.name: Diff was inspected
checks.assertion: Execution trace includes evidence that changed files or patch content were inspected.

checks.name: Findings were considered
checks.assertion: Execution trace or final output includes consideration of bugs, regressions, missing tests, or risks.

checks.name: Findings appear first
checks.assertion: The response begins with findings before summary or supporting context.
